name: Fingerprint only a changed style

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
## Compare kept layout styles exactly, without hashing

Mechanism: a claimed layout node hashed its requested style into a fingerprint and then, when equal, compared every field anyway (the exact check is what decides). Drop the redundant hash from the claim path and from the retained node (kept for the tests only). Allowed: fast/layout.rs. Forbidden: the field comparison.
measurementPlanMarkdown: ab.sh over div-cards, hover-grid, tree-toggle, dashboard-all-panels, dashboard-clock, 3 reps. Pass: no scenario slower, div-cards and all-panels CPU lower.
reportMarkdown:
## Compare kept layout styles exactly, without hashing Finished

Passed: true, small. The per-claim hash (3% of div-cards draw in the profile) is gone and each retained node is 8 bytes smaller; the exact field compare is unchanged, so a changed style is still detected the same way. `fast::tests::write_elision` (5) and `fast::tests::layout` (9) pass; clippy clean.
